# Official source regression snapshots

These sanitized HTML excerpts/snapshots were observed from MOL Sunflower first-party public pages on 2026-10-02. The operator retains rights in its source text; the CLI code license does not claim ownership of provider material. Routes/timetables/cabins/ports come from https://www.ferry-sunflower.co.jp/en/route/ ; anonymous fare-table shapes come from https://booking.ferry-sunflower.co.jp/ . No account/customer data, cookies or usable hidden anti-forgery values are retained. Fixtures test consequential parsing and never stand in for live evidence.
